concept: Noticing that one thing causes another thing to happen
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character notices a simple cause-and-effect chain (like watering a plant leads to it growing)
exercise.reflection_prompt: What caused what in the story?
exercise.practice: Student names one cause-and-effect pair from their own life

assessment.success_marker: student correctly identifies a real cause and its effect
